statements.impact_statement: Upstream glibc, NVD, Debian, Ubuntu, and Red Hat dispute this as a security vulnerability; the worker also runs non-root with a read-only root filesystem.
The reported behavior requires running ldd on an attacker-supplied ELF; upstream treats it as a non-security bug and the worker does not expose ldd or an ldd execution path.
